props.name: value
props.description: Controlled moment. null is an empty field.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a reading is committed — Enter, leaving the field, a calendar pick, or a suggestion.

props.name: referenceDate
props.description: The “now” that phrases are read against. Defaults to the current time.

props.name: dayFirst
props.description: Read 03/04 as 3 April (true) or March 4 (false). The other reading is still offered.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Pair with a Field for a visible one.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid from outside.

props.name: id
props.description: Overrides the generated id. Field supplies one.

props.name: 'aria-describedby'
props.description: Extra descriptions, such as a Field hint.
